title: Serenity Now | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Just minutes from the beach, Serenity Now is a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath retreat designed for relaxation, connection, and coastal adventures. Tucked away in Santa Rosa Beach, this pet-friendly home offers a tranquil setting, modern comfort, and easy access to the best of 30A.St
description_expanded: Just minutes from the beach, Serenity Now is a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath retreat designed for relaxation, connection, and coastal adventures. Tucked away in Santa Rosa Beach, this pet-friendly home offers a tranquil setting, modern comfort, and easy access to the best of 30A. Stylish, Comfortable & Designed for Togetherness Recently Upgraded Interiors – Coastal colors, stunning finishes, and thoughtfully styled spaces throughout. Open-Concept Living & Dining – Two cozy couches, comfy chairs, and plenty of room to gather, entertain, or unwind. Fully Equipped Kitchen – Cook up anything from beach snacks to full meals, with a breakfast bar and ample prep space. Dining Table for 6+ – Perfect for family meals, game nights, or morning coffee rituals. Peaceful Sleeping Spaces for Everyone First-Floor Master Suite – King-sized bed, flat-screen TV, and en suite bath—your personal oasis after sun-soaked days. Guest Bedroom – Another king-sized bed and flat-screen TV, offering comfort and privacy. Kid-Friendly Bunk Room – Features a twin-over-twin and full-over-full bunk setup, perfect for the little ones to relax and recharge. Outdoor Living & Pet-Friendly Perks Screened-In Porch – Enjoy breezy Florida evenings bug-free and blissful. Fenced-In Backyard – A spacious deck surrounded by mature trees creates a private retreat for you and your pup. Full-Sized Washer & Dryer – Clean up with ease after beach outings or backyard BBQs. Should you want to venture off the property, you’ll find lots to see and do nearby. With two beach access points less than half a mile away, spend lazy days soaking up the sun. Hike, bike, or paddle board through Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, then head to 3 Sons Bar-B-Q or Stinky’s Fish Camp for a sampling of the area’s tastiest food!. Pets must be under 75 lbs, and the non-refundable pet fee is a $300 addition included in the rate for all bookings made after July 15, 2025. If you are not bringing a pet, call us to have this removed. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Maximum of 3 cars! No street parking, no parking in the yard or across the street. Garage and 2 cars in the driveway only. This property is under 24 hour video surveillance. Cameras are pointed away from the home and do not face any interior areas. *Ring Camera on the front door
